rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every new northstar_research structure table, then drops review_event, document_review, document_simulation_link, document_block, project_membership, research_method, hypothesis and research_question. document_review/review_event hold org_research_confidential peer-review state and audit evidence, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place; the base research tables from 000010 are untouched.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_research has research_question, hypothesis, research_method, project_membership, document_block, document_simulation_link, document_review and review_event tables
row-level security is enabled and forced on every new northstar_research table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: GATE-RESEARCH-GA structure closers: research questions/hypotheses/methods/roles + document figure/table blocks, simulation link and the peer-review journey
